title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Relógio de ponto. Keep it, take the spike, take the category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Relógio de ponto
options.lineage: A wall time clock and the rack of cards it punches
options.thesis: You hold the lever to speak, and the card is not racked until you confirm the line the clock stamped.
options.viewport: Portrait. Seven separate cards in a metal rack, then the clock: a slot, a plate reading Pronto, and a lever marked Falar.
options.risk: Becomes a prop if the lever does not read as hold-to-talk, or if the card is too small to correct.

raised.raise: The card in hand is the only one that looks selected; an unpunched card looks unfinished.
The phase is stamped in words on the plate: Pronto, Gravando, Ouvindo, Sem microfone.
Each record is its own card, with air between it and the next.
A card not yet filed wears a physical clip.
The lever and the slot are stenciled with their verbs.
Confirm pulls that one card forward and the rack recedes.

options.label: Espeto de recados
options.lineage: Carbon-copy message slips on a desk spike
options.thesis: Each utterance is a slip, and it is not spiked until you confirm the line.
options.viewport: Portrait. Today’s slips stand on the spike; the slip being written fills the bottom, with Anotar and Rasgar.
options.risk: A spike of paper slips is the physical costume most secretary re-rolls land on.

options.label: Mesa de um bit
options.thesis: Records are overlapping windows on a dithered desktop.
options.viewport: Overlapping windows and a trash can on a stippled gray desk.
options.risk: A desktop of windows hides the day, and it is a screen, not the physical object you asked to keep.
options.case: Loses both: the re-roll asked for a physical thing, and windows do not scan as a day of errands.
options.kept: The selected object is unmistakable, and an unfinished one looks unfinished.

options.label: Terminal de fósforo
options.lineage: A green phosphor terminal in a machine room
options.thesis: The day is one scrolling transcript and a blinking cursor.
options.viewport: One column of green monospaced lines on black glass.
options.risk: A transcript is not one record per utterance, and the glass contradicts the physical steer.
options.case: Loses both: he did not ask for a terminal, and a scroll of lines fails confirm-then-file.

options.label: Pedreira de nuvem
options.lineage: A quarry where workers cut blocks of weather
options.thesis: Each record is a cloud block lifted out of a white cliff.
options.viewport: Stacked white blocks with blue gaps and a stencil tally.
options.risk: Weather construction is not a day of appointments.
options.case: Loses both: nobody keeps errands in a cloud quarry, and the sections are strata, not records.
options.kept: Separate masses with real gaps, not a flat table.

options.label: Etiqueta industrial
options.lineage: Stockroom streetwear: quotes, zip ties, hazard stripes
options.thesis: Every zone is a quoted label, and the active item still wears its tag.
options.viewport: White field, giant quoted words, an orange tag on the selected piece.
options.risk: Slogans in quotes replace the sentence he actually said.
options.case: Loses both: a fashion stockroom is not this day, and quoted labels cannot hold a title and a time.
options.kept: Not-yet-filed is a physical tag you can see.

options.label: Placa de nave
options.lineage: A used-future crew terminal with stenciled plates
options.thesis: You type one query and the glass answers in green capitals.
options.viewport: Curved black glass, one typed column, a hazard plate above it.
options.risk: Another screen of codes, which the physical re-roll was steering away from.
options.case: Loses both: a starship terminal is not the object in his hand, and one typed page hides the rack.
options.kept: Every control is stenciled with the verb it performs.

options.label: Mapa do jardim
options.lineage: A zoo guide map of flat color lobes
options.thesis: The day is swelling fields of flat color divided by a coastline.
options.viewport: One giant color lobe and a yellow capsule control.
options.risk: Flat graphic color is the opposite of the physical layout you asked to keep.
options.case: Loses both: a park map is not a secretary, and lobes are not appointments.
options.kept: One thing comes forward and the rest recedes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A round talk button and a plain list of today’s items, set as carefully as a good product screen.
canonCard.viewport: Portrait. The word Rafael, a large circular Segurar control, then the day’s rows underneath.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other voice inboxes, by design.
